meta.note: entry at the Monday close after the signal, 1-sigma stop, closes only; tags describe the signal week's position against weekly zones

waiting_tradeoff.note: Split by a future event (whether price came back to the zone), so it describes the trade-off of waiting, not a rule. The engine's Monday-close entry wins big when price never returns and loses badly when it does; the resting order rescues the returning subset and forgoes the runners.
